integrity: The proof is a direct Euclidean nearest-point argument. Completing the square reduces all genuine quadratics isometrically to the monomial graph. A two-nearest-point inequality gives the lower reach bound, and an explicit symmetry-axis family supplies two global nearest points at distances decreasing to the same constant. The lead article was checked at publication metadata, abstract, classification data, and accessible preview; targeted exact-formula searches found no covering statement.
scientific_limitations: The exact reach formula is proved for degree at most two and does not address exact tubular radii for higher-degree polynomial graphs. It identifies the geometric uniform-flatness scale but does not determine sharp Bargmann--Fock interpolation operator norms. The complete text of the recent lead article was unavailable for inspection, so an unindexed equivalent example inside that paper remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact uniform-flatness radius of every quadratic polynomial graph
